question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Peter was the last to know that she had been __cheating of him__.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cheating"** means acting dishonestly or unfairly in order to gain an advantage, especially in a game or examination. (धोखा देना)

 
 
• **Example: **He was caught** cheating** during the exam.
 
 
 
• **"Cheating on him"** refers to being unfaithful to him in a romantic relationship. (धोखा देना)
 
 
• **Example: **She was** cheating on him** with his best friend.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cheating in him** (उसमें धोखा देना): This phrase is grammatically incorrect and does not convey a meaningful sense in English.
 
• **Cheating up him** (उसके ऊपर धोखा देना): This phrase is also grammatically incorrect and not used in standard English.
 
• **Cheat of him** (उससे धोखा देना): This phrase could imply depriving him of something through deceit, but it is not the correct usage in the context of romantic unfaithfulness.
